title: 4x4 mesh, single 1-flit P2P 0 -> 15 (longest route): RTL parity

expected.notes: Opposite corners of a 4x4 mesh: Manhattan distance 3+3 = 6 (preregistered). flits=2 is post-hoc: a 4x4 flit header is 11 bits (4+4 source/dest, 2 flit_type, 1 vc), leaving 53 payload bits, so 7 payload bytes = 56 bits needs 2 flits.
